entries.title: An offer to look when a computer is short on memory
entries.body: With Computer cleanup enabled in Settings → Runbooks, the first mate now asks before starting a cleanup look using your plan’s allowance. After you agree, a crewmate offers leftovers grouped by finished task and explains what stopping each would cost. Programs no task owns are offered without a recommendation. Nothing stops until you pick it; programs belonging to open tasks stay running.
entries.noPicture: The offer and cleanup choices are written for each computer’s current programs, not a fixed app view.
